verdict.rationale: Datalab is a document-processing SaaS with an SDK, CLI and on-prem options, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any control to disable them in the SDK, CLI, dashboard or container. The enterprise air-gapped on-prem offering and the BAA/DPA terms address data residency and contracts. They do not document a user-facing opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking.
